$comment: Registry of tools/tests/vendored-drift.ps1. Members are discovered by AST: every definition of 'function' under 'root' is a copy.
authority: the copy every other copy must equal (the upstream authority of the family, in our layout); without it the largest group is the base.
localVariants: [{ files: [paths under root], reason: why this copy deliberately differs }]; files of one entry must be identical to each other.
maxVariants: a ratchet for a family whose copies legitimately differ - only growth past the number fails.
declaredBeforeUse.ignore: [{ file, function, reason }] for a false positive of the order check.
